⚠️ **Project-seat stub.** Job description: `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/ui.md`. This is **`domain:ui` seat 4**, seated on the maintainer's word 「再开一个 ui seat」 (Claude Code project "Objectstack 多币种 UI"). Seat 1 is #25966, seat 2 is #25995, seat 3 is #27561, seat 5 is #26945. The previous shift's vacant body (`zhuangjianguo` · `session_01QsR2jTfvjNTaR29ehLk26T`, clock-out brief 6458048972) is the body revision before this edit.

## Current PM

🟢 `os-bill` · Claude Code project "Objectstack 多币种 UI", seat thread "运行 ui 车道席位 4 派发" · `session_01Utp6CbDAucNyQ4UtzCJKyh` · summoned 2026-10-29T14:18Z, seated at this edit. Posture, ledger and round reports live in the project.

## Seat stub

- **File area (split from seat 1's remainder; seats 2 and 3 keep their recorded areas, agreed with both in the project):**
  - library packages — `ui/packages/` core, react, react-runtime, components, layout, providers, runner, i18n (except the `studio` namespace, seat 3), types, mobile, permissions, collaboration, data-objectstack, plugin-markdown, cli, create-plugin, test-support;
  - app-shell runtime pages outside Studio, Setup / admin, the record page and the list host — action dialogs (`ActionParamDialog`, `ActionConfirmDialog`, `ActionResultDialog`, `DeclaredActionsBar`, `FlowRunner`), notifications, global search, command palette and routing, approval pages, the import wizard, public forms and `/forms` pages, Home; `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/**` stays with seat 3, the `ObjectView` / `ObjectDataPage` list host with seat 2;
  - `ui/apps/console`, `packages/console` (dist generated by `pnpm console:build`, ⛔ never hand-edited), `ui/content/docs`.
  - Seat 1 (#25966) keeps its in-flight cards and its record-page serial chain to landing. Cards on one file stay with one seat and land in order. Claims carry `Seat: domain:ui#4`.
- **Excluded:** the `pm:epic` subtrees (#8345 multi-currency, run from the same project; #26676 record page).
- **Hot-file serial queue:** none held. In-flight seat-2 claims already reach into this area and stay seat 2's to land: `ui/packages/components/src/renderers/form/form.tsx` (#27247, #27483, #27519), `ui/packages/types/src/form.ts` + `zod/form.zod.ts` (#27247), `ui/packages/i18n` `useDisplayLocale.ts` + `ui/apps/console` `LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx` (#27498), app-shell `console/AppContent.tsx` (#27507 → PR #27590). Seat 3's #27480 touches `ui/packages/i18n` outbound/chatbot keys. Read those claims' `File surface:` lines before any claim on these files and serialise behind them. `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` stay ⛔ out of bounds for ui cards.
- **Standing constraints (maintainer):** changesets for ui cards go to the root `.changeset/`; no PR on the objectui repository; `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` is a gate on every ui card; no PR is assigned to or review-requested from the seat account — after seat ACCEPT and a same-head contract PASS, Tier H PRs request review from the governed approvers.
- **Mailbox:** none (a cloud seat container cannot create the `mailbox/<login>` branch). Reach the seat with a comment on this post or on a seat-4 claimed card.
- **Pointer:** posture and ledger live in the project; canonical ledger = labels + assignee + `Claim:` comments carrying `Seat: domain:ui#4` + `head:claude/` PRs.
- **Wall:** none.
